# Quora

7 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 7 advanced (5) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/quora/answers - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Quora answers matching a keyword, including the answer text, author name and credential, upvotes, views, and the parent question title.

**Use when** you need the answer body, not just the question title.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example learn programming. · e.g. `learn programming`
- `time` (optional, enum: all | hour | day | week | month | year) - Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language}; `post.author` {display_name, url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares, views}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/answers" \
  --data-urlencode "query=learn programming" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/quora/post - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns one Quora question from its URL: title, body text, and published date. Quora questions rarely have a separate body; content.text is the title. For written answers call GET /v1/quora/answers with a keyword.

**Use when** you have a question URL and need the title, text, and publish time.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Quora question, for example https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-alternative-to-SendGrid-Email-API. · e.g. `https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-alternative-to-SendGrid-Email-API`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language}; `post.engagement` {comments}; `post.flags` {deleted}.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/post" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.quora.com/What-is-the-best-alternative-to-SendGrid-Email-API" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/quora/posts - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns posts from Quora Spaces matching a keyword: URL, author, upvotes, comments, and publish time. Post body text is often absent from this search surface.

**Use when** you want to find Space posts. Question-and-answer threads are on search and answers.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords. · e.g. `learn programming`
- `time` (optional, enum: all | hour | day | week | month | year) - Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |
| `computed.estimated_reach` | Estimated reach based on views or follower count. |

+7 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {language}; `post.author` {display_name, url}; `post.engagement` {comments, likes, shares}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `quora/post` (`url` ← `data.items[].post.url`) - Get a Quora question.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/posts" \
  --data-urlencode "query=learn programming" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/quora/profiles - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Quora profiles matching a keyword: display name, profile URL, credential, follower count, and avatar.

**Use when** you want to find people or topic accounts on Quora before reading their answers.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example a topic or a person's name. · e.g. `learn programming`
- `time` (optional, enum: all | hour | day | week | month | year) - Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

**Response** `AuthorList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ author }` ([full schema](schemas/AuthorList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `author.id` | Platform-specific user ID… |
| `author.url` | Direct URL to the profile page |
| `author.avatar_url` | URL to profile picture |
| `author.bio` | Profile biography or description |
| `author.display_name` | Display name or full name |
| `author.followers` | Follower or subscriber count as an integer. |

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/profiles" \
  --data-urlencode "query=learn programming" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/quora/search - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Quora questions matching a keyword: title, URL, answer count, follower count, and publish time. Filter by recency with time. For written answers to a topic call GET /v1/quora/answers with the same query.

**Use when** you want to find questions on a topic. For the written answers themselves, call the answers endpoint with the same query.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords, for example learn programming. · e.g. `learn programming`
- `time` (optional, enum: all | hour | day | week | month | year) - Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

**Response** `PostList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/PostList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.published_at` | Post creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string. |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language}; `post.engagement` {comments}; `post.flags` {deleted}. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

## GET /v1/quora/spaces - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns Quora Spaces matching a keyword: name, URL, description, member count, and icon. Row shape follows the space search record.

**Use when** you want to discover Spaces, then search posts inside a topic with the posts endpoint.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Empty results** An upstream 404 means "zero items", not "not found" - you get `200 {items: []}` and a refund.
**Paging** single page - Upstream has no cursor. maxItemsPerQuery is a cap, probed 2026-09-01: limit=1 and limit=10 honoured, no page token in the schema or body.

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keywords. · e.g. `learn programming`
- `time` (optional, enum: all | hour | day | week | month | year) - Recency window: all, hour, day, week, month, or year. Default all.
- `limit` (optional, integer, 1-10) - Maximum rows to return, 1 to 10. Default 10.

**Response** `SearchResult` rows at `data.items[]` (inferred from a sample): {record_type string, url string, title string, text string}; `source_context` {seed_type string, seed_value string, source_url string, loaded_url string, scraped_at string, search_type string, search_time_filter string}; `status` {has_results boolean}; `metrics` {followers number, members number}; `media` {icon_url string}; `space` {id string, tribe_id number, name string, url string, description string}; `space.metrics` {followers number, members number}; `space.media` {icon_url string}.

Page-level: `data.dropped`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/quora/spaces" \
  --data-urlencode "query=learn programming" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
